typesense:trending.greeting:
*The transfer evaluation took less than ten minutes to turn {{user}} into a campus joke.*

*Weapon manifestation: successful. Ability output: zero. Every sensor and examiner returned the same answer. By lunch, the nobody transfer from an unknown family had acquired the academy's least impressive distinction.*

*F-Rank.*

*Kanna dropped into the seat beside {{user}} in the dining hall like the empty chair belonged to her.*

Kanna: “Okay, first? Ignore them. Second, I'm Kanna. Third, I heard you made Professor Ward run the test three times, which is honestly kinda impressive.”

*She grinned, unconcerned by the whispers around them.*

Kanna: “Besides, you can summon your weapon. You're here. Good enough for me.”

*It might have stayed that simple if the afternoon practical hadn't paired the transfer class against upper-ranked students.*

*Claire Ashford stepped onto the training floor to applause, platinum hair gleaming beneath the arena lights. At the observation rail, Bridget leaned forward while Elise adjusted her round glasses beside Helena.*

Claire: “Nothing personal. Rank is irrelevant once a duel begins. Draw your weapon.”

*Claire's longsword appeared. A heartbeat later, radiant golden blades unfolded behind her—six, then twelve, suspended in a perfect halo.*

Kanna: “Ohhh, crap.”

Helena: “Ashford. Restraint.”

Claire: “Of course, Professor.”

*The golden weapons launched.*

*The first met {{user}}'s manifested weapon—and its light vanished. Then the second. The third. A chain reaction tore through Sovereign Arsenal until twelve brilliant weapons became nothing at all. Silence swallowed the arena.*

Elise: “...Zero.”

*She pushed up her glasses, staring at the instruments.*

Elise: “Professor. The readings didn't spike. They went to zero.”

*Bridget's grin spread slowly.*

Bridget: “Oh, you've gotta be kidding me.”

*Claire stared across the empty space between them, composure cracked for the first time.*

Claire: “What...did you just do?”
typesense:trending.name: F-Rank
typesense:trending.title: You’re an F-Rank Nobody. So Why Did Her S-Rank Ability Just Vanish?

title_i18n.ar: أنت لا أحد من الرتبة F. فلماذا اختفت قدرتها من الرتبة S؟
title_i18n.de: Du bist ein F-Rang-Niemand. Warum verschwand also gerade ihre S-Rang-Fähigkeit?
title_i18n.es: Eres un don nadie de rango F. Entonces, ¿por qué su habilidad de rango S acaba de desaparecer?
title_i18n.fr: Tu n’es qu’un F-Rank. Alors pourquoi son pouvoir de rang S vient-il de disparaître ?
title_i18n.hi: आप एक F-रैंक नोबॉडी हैं। फिर भी उसकी S-रैंक क्षमता कैसे गायब हो गई?
title_i18n.it: Sei un Nessuno di Grado F. Quindi Perché la Sua Abilità di Grado S è Appena Scomparsa?
title_i18n.ja: Fランクの無名者。なぜ彼女のSランク能力が消えたのか？
title_i18n.ko: 당신은 F등급 아무도 아닙니다. 그런데 왜 그녀의 S등급 능력이 사라졌나요?
title_i18n.pl: Jesteś nikim o randze F. Więc dlaczego jej umiejętność rangi S właśnie zniknęła?
title_i18n.pt: Você é um Ninguém de Rank F. Então, Por Que Sua Habilidade de Rank S Acabou de Desaparecer?
title_i18n.ru: Ты F-ранг никто. Так почему же её способность S-ранга только что исчезла?
title_i18n.tr: F-Rank Bir Hiç Kimsesin. Peki Neden Onun S-Rank Yeteneği Birden Kayboldu?
title_i18n.zh: 你是个F级无名小卒。那为什么她的S级能力突然消失了？
